title: Fix the Function Returning the Wrong Variable
description: The program should return the larger of two numbers from a function.
expectedBehavior: maximum(3, 9) should return 9, the larger of the two numbers.
actualProblem: The fallback return statement always returns a regardless of which value was actually larger, so maximum(3, 9) incorrectly returns 3 instead of 9.
explanation: The fallback path (when a is not greater than b) needs to return b, the other candidate value. Returning the wrong variable silently produces incorrect results with no compiler warning.
